item.title: Hermes Agent - Getting more popular then openclaw
item.description: AI agents have become one of the most transformative technologies in software development, and Hermes Agent by Nous Research stands at the forefront of this revolution. Unlike conventional AI assistants that operate in stateless isolation, Hermes introduces a paradigm shift: the agent that grows with you. With over 150,000 GitHub stars and an active community of thousands of developers, Hermes has rapidly become the most significant open-source AI agent project in existence.
